title: Storage Lot Grace Days in the Redemption Expense Payment under Repossession and Collateral Recovery
content:
Storage lot grace terms for the redemption expense payment on a Repossession and Collateral Recovery case, read from the storage lot recorded on the case.

**Rule.** For the redemption expense payment, where the case's storage lot is Lakeshore Vehicle Storage - Milwaukee or Twin Ports Auto Storage - Duluth and the payment date is no more than 30 calendar days after the recovery date, the grace days deducted are 5; where the storage lot is Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park or Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland, the grace days deducted are 0; in every other case the grace days deducted are the class free days.

| Storage lot on the case | Payment date | Grace days deducted |
|---|---|---|
| Lakeshore Vehicle Storage - Milwaukee or Twin Ports Auto Storage - Duluth | no more than 30 calendar days after the recovery date | 5 |
| Lakeshore Vehicle Storage - Milwaukee or Twin Ports Auto Storage - Duluth | more than 30 calendar days after the recovery date | the class free days |
| Peachtree Auto Holding - Forest Park or Lake Erie Auto Storage - Cleveland | any | 0 |
| any other lot | any | the class free days |

## Window boundary (hypothetical recovery date of 1 March, vehicle at Twin Ports Auto Storage - Duluth)

- Payment on 31 March (30 days after): 5 grace days are deducted.
- Payment on 1 April (31 days after): the class free days are deducted.
